fusions.name: Shackling Blow
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Iron Maiden
fusions.desc: Drives spikes out of your plate, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drop the Portcullis
fusions.desc: Drops a wall of bars 6 tiles long that nothing crosses, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Turnkey's Calm
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
